title: Reflections – A Star Wars UE4 Real-Time Ray Tracing Cinematic Demo
original_title: Reflections – A Star Wars UE4 Real-Time Ray Tracing Cinematic Demo
overview: Developed by Epic Games in collaboration with NVIDIA and ILMxLAB, "Reflections" is an experimental short cinematic set in the Star Wars universe. Featuring Captain Phasma and two First Order stormtroopers inside an elevator, the project showcases a massive leap forward in the convergence of film and real-time graphics rendering using Unreal Engine 4 and DirectX Ray Tracing (DXR) technology.
